review:
A savannah stampede on 6x4 with 4,096 ways. Whenever the Super Wildebeest lands in the base game, it adds a random number of paying symbols to random spots.

Three to six scatters give 8, 12, 16 or 20 free spins, where wilds carry 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers that multiply each other, and up to 15 wildebeest get collected into a meter – then dropped all at once when the Super Wildebeest lands. 96.45% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
